name: @refarm.dev/quality-checker-plugin
description: quality:v1 checker as a refarm integration plugin — the second real consumer of dispatch-result:v1, proving the async result contract generalizes across plugin families.

scripts.build:plugin: pnpm run bundle:plugin && jco componentize dist/plugin.bundled.js --wit ../refarm-plugin-wit/wit --world-name refarm-plugin --disable all -o dist/quality_plugin.wasm && jco transpile dist/quality_plugin.wasm -o pkg-plugin --name quality_plugin --no-wasi-shim --instantiation async && node scripts/write-plugin-manifest.mjs
